title: Chansey Got Fast Because Others Wanted Its Egg
premise: Chansey was once very slow, then became able to flee quickly to protect its eggs from other creatures.
audiencePromise: Watch Chansey transform from slow and careful into a fast escape artist.
openLoop: How can a slow Pokémon protect an egg that people and Pokémon want?
payoff: Chansey handles two egg threats: careful walking prevents breaks, while fleeing avoids creatures.
engagementQuestion: Which protects its egg better: careful walking or quick fleeing?

voice.instructions: Warm and quick, like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange Pokédex detail. Stress “slow,” “egg,” and “fast.” Pause briefly before the final question.

scenes.headline: THE EGG WAS THE TARGET
scenes.narration: Chansey got fast because others wanted its egg.
scenes.caption: OTHERS WANTED ITS EGG

scenes.headline: SLOW WAS CAREFUL
scenes.narration: Chansey was once very slow, and walked carefully to prevent breaks.
scenes.caption: ONCE SLOW. WALKS CAREFULLY.

scenes.headline: PEOPLE AND POKÉMON WANTED IT
scenes.narration: People overharvested its eggs, while other Pokémon tried taking them.
scenes.caption: THE EGGS KEPT GETTING TARGETED

scenes.headline: THEN IT FLED QUICKLY
scenes.narration: To protect those eggs, Chansey became able to flee quickly.
scenes.caption: SLOW WALKING → QUICK FLEEING

scenes.headline: FEWER CHANSEY REMAINED
scenes.narration: But overharvesting left Chansey few in number and difficult to find.
scenes.caption: FEW IN NUMBER. HARD TO FIND.

scenes.headline: TWO WAYS TO PROTECT IT
scenes.narration: Which protects its egg better: careful walking or quick fleeing?
scenes.caption: CAREFUL WALKING OR QUICK FLEEING?
